cards.title: Sparse NCA Mean Curve and Nominal Time Requirement
cards.claim: For sparse sampling analysis, the NCA object calculates a mean concentration curve by taking the mean concentration value for each unique time value. It is recommended to use nominal time rather than actual time for these analyses to ensure correct grouping.
limitations: Using actual time instead of nominal time may disrupt the mean curve calculation logic.
This is a software implementation detail, not a universal statistical rule for all sparse methods.
cards.downstream_use: Data preparation for sparse NCA analysis; ensuring time variables are formatted as nominal categories.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
